title: Plan Sync groups stop disappearing
description:
Saving Plan View was stripping Plan Sync groups from storage, so groups looked fine until refresh/login and then vanished. The server now keeps planSync (groups) on every save, merges groups safely so a stale empty write cannot wipe them, and the client saves immediately when you create a group.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync (map34). Re-save any group once if it was lost before this fix so it is written back to storage.
changeLog: Server plan-view save no longer drops planSync/groups on v2 payloads.
Merge Plan Sync groups on save so empty/stale writes cannot wipe them.
Saving a Plan Sync group now persists immediately (not only after debounce).
Hydrate merges groups instead of replacing local groups with empty server data.
